title: Pawnbroker and second-hand dealer licences
summary: This page provides information and links for pawnbroker and second-hand dealer licence services in NSW.

faqs.q: How do I apply for a pawnbroker or second-hand dealer licence?
faqs.a: You can apply for a pawnbroker licence or a second-hand dealer licence using the dedicated application links.

faqs.q: What if I need to renew or replace my licence?
faqs.a: You can renew, replace, or restore your pawnbroker or second-hand dealer licence through the service links.

faqs.q: How do I change my licence details or class?
faqs.a: The service provides options to change the details or the class on an existing pawnbroker or second-hand dealer licence.

faqs.q: What is the process for surrendering a licence?
faqs.a: You can surrender a pawnbroker or second-hand dealer licence using the provided service link.
